entries.347a9fd178667d9b: The company is a holding company, and the group consists of 13 companies in total: the company, 9 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 non-consolidated subsidiaries. Its main businesses are the manufacture and sale of frozen foods centered on Chinese prepared dishes, and the chain operation of restaurants focused on everyday meals; the number of consolidated employees as of February 28, 2026 was 564.

entries.8e8acb33904c46eb: A business that manufactures and sells frozen foods and others under the Osaka Ohsho brand.
entries.a59da3d0a9f6f1d2: A holding company that manufactures and sells frozen foods under the "Osaka Ohsho" brand and also operates restaurant chains such as Chinese restaurants.
entries.c57b7e4b4e569d6f: A business that operates company-owned restaurants centered on the popular Chinese cuisine brand Osaka Ohsho, as well as the ramen shops Yotteko-ya and Taiyo no Tomato-men, the bakery cafés R Baker and Koshiniru, and the Ippinko restaurants specializing in tanmen noodles, and develops its own brands through franchise chains. As of February 28, 2026, the number of stores totaled 471, comprising 117 company-operated stores and 354 franchised stores, and external customer revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥17,259 million.
entries.fc9c76032dba7c8f: A business that operates company-owned restaurants centered on the popular Chinese cuisine brand Osaka Ohsho, as well as the ramen shops Yotteko-ya and Taiyo no Tomato-men, the bakery cafés R Baker and Koshiniru, and the Ippinko restaurants specializing in tanmen noodles, and develops its own brands through franchise chains.
entries.fe04edab37c364a8: A business that manufactures and sells frozen foods and others under the Osaka Ohsho brand. Frozen gyoza and others produced at group plants in Itakura Town, Oura County, Gunma Prefecture and in Hirakata City, Osaka Prefecture are sold through wholesalers to consumer cooperatives and general mass retailers nationwide, and are also sold directly to general consumers through mail order. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥23,197 million.
